title: Medallion rug in a blue ground, late 18th/early 19th century, Azerbaijan
notes: Medallion rug in a blue ground, late 18th/early 19th century, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 13 May 1916. inv. no 99 (1904) from the Mosque of Korkmazoglu, Sivas. 270 x 593 cm. catalogue as Kuba copy of Safavid carpet. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 99.
